mapper.select: SELECT CASE send_status WHEN 0 THEN 'PENDING' WHEN 1 THEN 'SENDING' WHEN 2 THEN 'SUCCESS' WHEN 3 THEN 'FAILED' WHEN 4 THEN 'PARTIAL' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS statusKey, COUNT(*) AS statusCount FROM msg_send_record WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY send_status

SELECT TO_CHAR(create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS dateStr, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN send_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN send_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedCount FROM msg_send_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '#{days} days' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY dateStr ASC
